visual: Clump-forming bulbous perennial with rich green strap-shaped leaves and erect leafless autumn stems carrying umbels of striking dark rose-pink flowers, each around 6–8 cm across with strongly wavy, reflexed petals.
water: Keep moderately moist during active growth, but ensure excellent drainage and avoid leaving the bulbs in persistently wet soil.
soilWarning: Winter wet rots the bulb; needs full sun
prune: No routine pruning required; remove spent flower heads unless seed is wanted and clear foliage only after it has naturally died back.
toxicity: Ornamental bulbs are potentially harmful if eaten; gloves are advisable when handling.
resilience: Hardy through most of the UK when planted in a sunny, sheltered, freely draining position; a dry winter mulch can provide extra protection in colder gardens.
uses: Sunny borders, gravel gardens, Mediterranean-style planting, cottage gardens, wall-side borders, coastal gardens and cut flowers.
uncertain: Cultivar identification as 'Isabel' is based on the supplied photograph rather than a plant label, so it should be treated as probable rather than confirmed.
